newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker, spooked by Dow losses.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker, spooked by Dow losses.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started Monday's session one percent lower and below the key psychological 5,000 level, tracking a big fall for the Dow on Friday, dealers said.
The index was 53.8 points off at 4,977.5 by 0743 GMT. The Dow ended 156.78 points off at 8,031.22.
Stocks trading ex-dividend took 15.41 points off the key UK index with BT trading 46-1/2p lower to 380p as it went ex-special-dividend amid continuing worries over its MCI tie-up.
Nervousness ahead of inflation data, due out at 0830 GMT, will add extra caution to early trading, dealers said.
